summary.root_cause_text: Config change payment_provider_url payments-v1 -> payments-v2 (ops, provider migration) caused orders to be processed without payment. Worker thread stalled (heartbeat 20s old) with a growing queue; cause unknown, cleared by restart.
recommended: Check why payments-v2 fails silently before retrying the migration.
